{{Quote|What I want is a comfortable ride home. But let's not confuse the chain of command. I'm the trigger, Supervisor. You're the finger. Make sure you're available.|Kaido to Dedra Meero|<ref name="WAY?">{{Andor|Who Are You?}}</ref>}}
[[Captain]] '''Kaido''' was an [[Imperial Army]] [[Imperial officer|officer]] who was a crisis specialist. Kaido was deployed to [[Ghorman]] to oversee the tactical execution of the [[Ghorman project]], instigating the local population to warrant an Imperial response.<ref name="Messenger">{{Andor|Messenger}}</ref> After [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]] ordered him to proceed, Kaido's forces angered the crowd into reacting, with an Imperial [[Unidentified Imperial sniper|sniper]] [[Death|killing]] an Imperial to allow Kaido's forces to begin firing into the civilian crowd. The subsequent firefight evolved into the [[Ghorman Massacre]].<ref name="WAY?" />

==Biography==

===Dropping the lure===
{{Quote|Captain Kaido is a crisis specialist. He'll be bringing a variety of personnel to help manage the situation.|Major Lio Partagaz|<ref name="Messenger" />}}
Kaido was a [[human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] during its reign, holding the rank of [[Captain]] in the [[Imperial Army]] by [[2 BBY]]. Regarded as a crisis specialist and problem solver, Kaido was dispatched to the planet [[Ghorman]] alongside a [[Ghorman crisis team|special team]] that [[Standard year|year]], with the goal of manufacturing a massacre to justify an Imperial occupation and genocide. Upon his arrival, he brought in several squads of [[Imperial security trooper|infantry]], including [[Sergeant]] [[Bloy]]'s [[Bloy's riot squad|squad]], and began to fortify [[Palmo Plaza]] in preparation for the riot.<ref name="Messenger" />{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I see Imperial uniforms, Sergeant. I see a barricade lane to the Memorial that I need kept open. You will march them out there immediately and secure the area. Or you can all finish your days in an Imperial brig.|Kaido to Sergeant Bloy|<ref name="WAY?" />}}
Kaido was a human [[Gender|male]] with short [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], blue [[eye]]s, and light skin, bearing a large scar on his left cheek.<ref name="Messenger" /> Kaido had a stern command style and showed little regard for those beneath him, even ordering the deaths of Imperial personnel to achieve his aims. He was also openly condescending toward his superior and made it clear he wanted only to return home without incident.<ref name="WAY?" /> Unrepentant for his actions, Kaido met the sight of the Ghorman Massacre with a pleased smile.<ref name="WhoAD">{{Andor|Who Are You?}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Kaido wore a black [[Imperial officer's uniform]] with a matching [[Imperial kepi]] and [[cape]]. He bore a [[code cylinder]] in his right pocket and a [[rank insignia plaque]] with one blue and three red tiles.<ref name="Messenger" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kaido was portrayed by [[Jonjo O'Neill]].<ref name="Messenger" />
